name: rehearsal-db
description: See whether database changes are ready for a safe local rehearsal without memorizing CLI commands.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Rehearsal shows static guidance only and runs no workspace process until the folder is trusted.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Rehearsal requires a local project and its workspace-installed CLI.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Open a local project to see whether its database changes are ready.
[Open Rehearsal Workspace](command:rehearsal.openWorkspace)
[Read the getting-started guide](command:rehearsal.openDocumentation)

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Rehearsal
walkthroughs.description: Understand your project, create a safe local baseline, and test database changes before deployment.

steps.title: Open your application project
steps.description: Open the folder that contains `package.json` and your database migrations. Rehearsal never borrows a package from another repository.

steps.title: Open the Rehearsal workspace
steps.description: [Open Project Workspace](command:rehearsal.openWorkspace) to see detected facts, suggestions, decisions, migration state, and local runtime status.

steps.title: Follow the next best step
steps.description: Use the primary action on Overview. Installation and data changes require explicit approval or Rehearsal's guided review; separately opted-in automatic updates retain your saved authorization.

commands.title: Rehearsal: View Privacy and Data Use

rehearsal.automaticUpdates.markdownDescription: Explicit opt-ins for this computer's user settings: `extension` installs verified official Rehearsal VSIX updates; `cli` updates compatible registry-backed npm Rehearsal packages in trusted idle projects, preserving dependency group and lockfile and disabling install scripts. Both default off. These choices authorize public release checks. Projects cannot enable them. No forced reloads, migrations or database lifecycle operations.

rehearsal.configPath.markdownDescription: Optional project-relative path passed to Rehearsal as `--config=<path>`. Leave empty to use the CLI's fail-closed discovery.

rehearsal.inspectionTimeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Maximum time for each read-only Rehearsal inspection command. Increase this only when a large local project needs more time; the extension still cancels only processes it owns.

rehearsal.openDashboardAutomatically.markdownDescription: Open the Rehearsal dashboard automatically once when a trusted single-folder project is first inspected in this VS Code window. Disable this when you prefer to open it from the Rehearsal sidebar or Command Palette.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:controller && npm run format:check
